# ExecutionPlanOptimizer

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.ExecutionPlanOptimizer`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Optimizes a PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanResult by applying transformation passes to the plan node tree. Current optimization passes: Predicate pushdown: moves client-side WHERE conditions into FetchXML where possible. Constant folding: evaluates constant expressions at plan time (e.g., 1 + 1 becomes 2). Sort elimination: removes unnecessary client-side sort when data is already ordered.
